## External display

- The controller keeps working while the stream is on the TV: the game's artwork page on the device and the TV's window now pass the controller to the game instead of to the app.
- In Second Screen mode the touch controls are no longer drawn over the game on the TV. With mirroring they follow Stream Settings as usual.
- The statistics overlay now shows on the TV when the stream is there.

## Stream menu

- New Stream Settings in the stream menu, without leaving the game. Video settings (resolution, frame rate, bitrate, codec, HDR, frame pacing, Multi-Controller Mode) are applied with Apply and Reconnect: the stream reconnects in a few seconds and the game keeps running on the PC. Controls (Touch Mode, On-Screen Controls, Swap A/B and X/Y) apply right away. Works by touch and with the controller (← → change a value).
